# Engineering Tutorial: Designing a Reliable Request-Processing Service

## 1. Introduction

In modern distributed systems, a "reliable service" is not merely one that works under ideal conditions; it is one that continues to function correctly, predictably, and safely when things go wrong. The core responsibility of such a service is to manage the lifecycle of a unit of work—from the moment a request arrives at the network boundary to the moment a result is persisted or an error is gracefully surfaced.
